summary: Aunt by marriage of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan (wife of his uncle Richard), possibly also his blood aunt, and later stepmother of his wife Mary Connole.
bio: Anastasia ('Anty') Boney married Richard Heffernan (bapt. 1806) at Gortnahoe on 12 Feb 1827; they lived at Mardyke; Richard died in Ireland and she emigrated to Plymouth with her children. In the 1860 Plymouth census, as 'Anna S. Heppen', 47, she lived with son James and Jeremiah Boney, 30 (probable relative). After 1860 she became the second wife of the widower Thomas Connole, making her Mary Connole's stepmother. She died at Plymouth on 3 Aug 1896 aged 84. Her obituary says she married twice, her first husband died in Ireland, her children were James Heffernan and Katherine Heffernan Grimes, and her stepchildren were Mrs. Andrew Heffernan, John F. Connole and Mrs. William Dalley; John F. Connole's obituary calls her 'Ann (Boner) Connole'. Surviving children: Catherine (1833-1908, m. Edmund Grimes), John (1835-1891, m. Margaret Fennelly), James (1838-1910, m. Ellen Kelly). The deep-dive report proposed she and Catherine Boney were sisters married to two Heffernans; Dwyer does not state it, so it stays probable-unproven.
